task_text: Load a coasting cart, throw the switch, recover the part: A small cube (the part) rides a powered roller conveyor, and an unpowered cart is already coasting along a straight channel towards a passive hinged switch that splits the track into two diagonal branches. Grasp the part with both fingers while it is still moving and lift it, drop it into the moving cart, then push the switch with a finger so that it will steer the cart into the branch selected for this instance (one of the two sides, drawn per instance and given under Goal geometry) before the cart reaches it. The cart must then be deflected by the switch into that branch. Finally, grasp the part again, lift it out of the cart and hold it up before the cart runs too far down the branch. Phases, in order: moving_part_pickup: Both fingers grip the part (bilateral grip: the left finger or its pad and the right finger or its pad are both in contact with the part at that physics step) at some moment when the part moves faster than 0.025 m/s. After that (same or later step), with the part still gripped, its centre is higher than z = 0.20 m.; load_coasting_cart: At a step when the part is not gripped by both fingers, the part touches the cart's tray while the cart moves faster than 0.02 m/s.; physical_switch_operation: During this phase a finger (either finger or finger pad) touches the switch. After that, at some step: the switch angle q (about the vertical hinge, counterclockwise seen from above; q = 0 is the blade pointing from its hinge towards -y) is turned towards the selected branch by more than 0.50 rad, i.e. -branch x q > 0.50 (q < -0.50 rad when branch = +1, the +x side; q > +0.50 rad when branch = -1); the switch turns slower than 0.12 rad/s; and the cart's origin is still at y < 0.105. If, before this, the cart touches the switch or its origin passes y = 0.105, the task fails (missed_switch_deadline).; selected_branch: During this phase the cart touches the switch and touches the guide rail of the selected branch (`branch_rail_{branch}`), in either order. Then the cart's origin is at y > 0.23 and on the selected side, with branch x x > 0.08 (x > 0.08 for branch +1, x < -0.08 for branch -1).; payload_recovery: Both fingers grip the part, its centre is more than 0.10 m above the cart's origin (the centre of the cart floor's top surface), and the part does not touch the cart, for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task. Goal geometry: At this instance the selected branch is branch -1: the diagonal branch on the -x side (the side nearer the robot's base). Lines in the world frame used by the predicates: part lift height z = 0.20 m; switch deadline y = 0.105 for the cart's origin; branch reached at y > 0.23 with |x| > 0.08 on the selected side; recovery window ends at |x| = 0.27 or y = 0.43 for the cart's origin.
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where the task has succeeded (every phase in order) or failed (a failure event, a forbidden contact, a safety-limit violation, an object out of bounds, or the task's horizon of 25 s of simulated time, 2500 control steps), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
